quotes.text: The Accounts v2 API is generally available for Connect users, and in public preview for other Stripe users.
To join the Accounts v2 preview, go to [Account previews and features](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/previews) in your Dashboard and enable **Reusable payment methods for Global Payouts**.

Create a customer-configured [Account](https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/accounts/create.md#v2_create_accounts-configuration-customer) or [Customer](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers/create.md) when your customer creates an account with your business, or when saving a payment method. Associate the object’s ID with your own internal representation of a customer.
If you [represent your customers as customer-configured Account objects](https://docs.stripe.com/accounts-v2/use-accounts-as-customers.md), replace `customer` in this example with `customer_account`.

If you configure `add_invoice_items` on future phases, invoice items won’t be generated until that phase begins.

findings: The unchanged core setup requires enabling Boleto in payment settings and a Stripe-hosted confirmation link, then choosing send_invoice or charge_automatically (old raw lines 18-36; new raw lines 9-29). A sent invoice needs a due date and customer entry of name, address and tax ID each cycle; automatic collection relies on the customer's default Boleto PaymentMethod and emails a voucher, whose expiration need not match invoice due dates (old raw lines 24-36; new raw lines 17-29).

The new guide makes the earlier Accounts v2 recommendation actionable: customer-configured Account creation with configuration.customer and an explicit 2026-10-28.preview header for preview users, versus Customers v1 creation; v1 PaymentMethod attach uses customer_account for the Account path and customer for the Customer path; default payment method is configuration.customer.billing.default_payment_method versus invoice_settings.default_payment_method (old raw lines 8-14, 98-188; new raw lines 81-91, 95-220).

The new subscription and Checkout examples carry customer_account or customer for the two identity paths; both retain send_invoice/charge_automatically, default_incomplete, days_until_due or off_session, and Checkout mode=subscription with Boleto voucher expiration (old raw lines 302-378; new raw lines 326-416). Subscription schedules retain future/current phase add_invoice_items timing, with a new customer_account substitution instruction (old raw lines 380-413; new raw lines 418-437).

Old send_invoice example explicitly set payment_settings.payment_method_types to card and boleto (old raw lines 310-329); both new cURL examples omit that parameter (new raw lines 336-358). This is a material example delta, not proof that the setting became invalid or unnecessary; current source line 34 should retain its dated old-example scope and explain the new omission. Other Node-to-cURL changes, list numbering, example names/start_date and changed navigation links are presentation or sample changes (diff lines 1-715).

The current source only cites the May 2026 old raw (source lines 4-7, 38-40) and models only Customer v1 (source lines 13, 28-34); it needs November provenance and a version/identity-aware Account v2 addition. Its 'charge_automatically' wording must not imply automatic cash debit or payment success: the related Boleto invoice source says the customer still actively pays a voucher (wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto-invoices.md:13,25; wiki/concepts/stripe-vouchers.md:55).

Related source and concept context says Boleto refunds are unavailable (wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto.md:25; wiki/concepts/stripe-vouchers.md:49). The generic Dashboard subscription-edit option to refund the last payment (old raw line 286; new raw line 312) cannot be taken as a Boleto refund capability; add a reciprocal scope warning if describing that UI option in this Boleto summary.
substantive_changes: Explicit, parameterized Accounts v2 customer-configured Account flow alongside retained Customers v1, including preview/version condition, v2 configuration.customer, v1 customer_account attachment/subscription/Checkout identity and v2 billing default field (old raw lines 8-14, 98-188, 302-413; new raw lines 81-220, 336-437).

The old send_invoice sample's explicit card/Boleto payment_method_types is absent from both November cURL samples (old raw lines 310-329; new raw lines 336-358); treat as changed sample contents with requirement status unresolved, not policy removal.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the 2026-05-07 old raw and source provenance, including the older Node Customer v1 example and explicit card/Boleto payment method list (source lines 4-7, 34, 38-40; old raw lines 310-329). Add the 2026-11-07 capture without rewriting history.

The old Accounts v2 recommendation and preview scope already existed in May (old raw lines 8-14); the November capture adds concrete API examples and preview enrollment wording (new raw lines 81-113), not first support for Accounts v2.

Preserve both captures' collection-method and delayed voucher behavior (old raw lines 24-36, 302-378; new raw lines 17-29, 326-416) and the separate invoice source's active voucher-payment qualification (wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto-invoices.md:13,25).
conflicts: Generic Dashboard subscription-edit text offers refunding the last payment (old raw line 286; new raw line 312), while Boleto-specific source says no Boleto refunds (wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto.md:25); the Dashboard statement needs a payment-method scope caveat wherever repeated, and the Boleto no-refund warning should point back to the generic UI limit.

The old send_invoice example and current source line 34 specify card plus Boleto payment_method_types, whereas the new Customer v1 and Account v2 send_invoice examples omit it (old raw lines 310-329; new raw lines 336-358). Preserve both dated examples and avoid asserting either universal requirement or deprecation from omission.
unresolved_questions: The pinned page does not establish whether omitting payment_settings.payment_method_types in November changes the default allowed payment methods for any account; live account configuration and API behavior were not tested (new raw lines 336-358).

The document states Accounts v2 is generally available for Connect and public preview for others but provides a 2026-10-28.preview example; account-specific preview enrollment and version availability were not verified (new raw lines 81-113).

findings: Add the November raw provenance and explicit Account v2 versus Customer v1 paths with version/preview gates and distinct identity/default-payment fields (source lines 4-7, 28-34, 38-40; new raw lines 81-220, 336-416).

Keep both collection-method descriptions and Boleto voucher email, expiration, due-date, and tax-ID prerequisites, qualifying charge_automatically as voucher generation rather than auto-debit (source lines 13-36; new raw lines 17-29; wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto-invoices.md:25).
Date the old explicit payment_method_types example because November samples omit it; do not claim the setting was removed or forbidden (old raw lines 310-329; new raw lines 336-358; source line 34).
conflicts: Generic subscription Dashboard refund option is not evidence of Boleto refund support (new raw line 312; wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto.md:25).
Old explicit card/Boleto sample and new omitted list require reciprocal dated qualification (old raw lines 310-329; new raw lines 336-358).
source_assessments.reason: New identity/version-specific Accounts v2 procedures and changed send_invoice sample materially outgrow the Customer-only summary; preserve old evidence and payment outcome boundaries.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/set-up-subscription, enable Boleto and the hosted confirmation link, then choose send_invoice, which requires a due date and fresh customer details per cycle, or charge_automatically, which needs a default Boleto PaymentMethod carrying name, Brazilian address and tax ID and emails a voucher each cycle. The new guide supplies customer-configured Accounts v2 and Customers v1 alternatives: an Account ID travels as customer_account through attach, subscription and Checkout calls, while a Customer ID travels as customer; their default-payment fields differ. Accounts v2 has a Connect/general-availability versus other-user preview/version boundary. Subscription and Checkout creation, including default_incomplete or success_url, do not prove voucher payment. These details span old raw lines 8-36, 98-188, 302-413 and new raw lines 9-29, 81-220, 326-437. source-stripe-boleto-subscription.md captures the older Customer v1 flow but lacks the new concrete Account path and provenance.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/set-up-subscription, the substantive November addition is a concrete Accounts v2 route with configuration.customer, customer_account and a preview-version example, beyond the prior recommendation in old raw lines 8-14, 98-188 versus new raw lines 81-220. The old send_invoice code explicitly lists card and Boleto methods, while new samples omit that list (old raw lines 310-329; new raw lines 336-358); preserve both as dated examples without inferring deprecation or defaults. Node-to-cURL conversion, numbering, links and sample timestamps are presentation or navigation. source-stripe-boleto-subscription.md should retain May provenance and add November's identity boundaries. Keep secret-key calls server-side, qualify Accounts v2 preview eligibility, and distinguish generated/emailed vouchers and a Checkout success URL from cash payment, invoice settlement or subscription activation. The generic Dashboard refund menu must be scoped against the Boleto-specific no-refund source.
